newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU APPROVES GENE-MODIFIED RAPESEED VARIETIES.
newsitem.headline: EU APPROVES GENE-MODIFIED RAPESEED VARIETIES.

text.p: The European Commission on Friday approved the release of two herbicide resistant genetically modified rapeseed varieties, EU Commission officials said.
The varieties were developed by Belgium-based biotech company Plant Genetic Systems.
A Commission official said that approval, through the so-called written procedure, was given after the company agreed to voluntary labelling of the products.
Labelling is not compulsory for the 11 genetically modified products which are being examined by the European Commission.
Further details are due to be released on Monday.
Approval follows a French government request to the Commission in July 1995.
The Commission has already approved the release of a genetically modified maize strain sold by Novartis and Monsanto's gene-modified soybeans.
